item.title: Wyoming · The purpose of this meeting is to consider draft legislation defining minor capital construction for K-12 school facilities; authorizing a portion of major maintenance funding to be used for minor capital construction projects; and providing for the identification, prioritization and funding of minor capital construction and other component projects. The meeting will be held remotely, with a live video stream available on the Legislature's Website (www.wyoleg.gov).
